name: David Tepper

views.text: If a coach is not getting it done, I will not wait out the season.
Drafting a quarterback first overall was the right call, and I will defend it.
I give a new coach control of his staff, and I expect results quickly.
The stadium and the city deserve investment, and I will put my own money in.
People call me impatient; I call it refusing to accept losing.
I bring my own people in to run things the way I want.

want: Turn the Panthers into a consistent winner worthy of his investment (medium).
fear: Being seen as the reason the franchise keeps failing (medium).
voice: Blunt, competitive and impatient, a hedge-fund trader's directness. Defends his decisions combatively and shows his frustration openly.

evidence.summary: After Tepper fired Frank Reich 11 games into his first season, CBS argued the owner was the bigger issue, citing reports of meddling and a pattern of mid-season firings.
Carolina hired Dave Canales, the seventh head coach (including interims) since Tepper bought the team in 2018.
Tepper committed another $500 million to the Bank of America Stadium renovation, bringing the total to about $1.3 billion.

review.notes: JR approved 2026-11-07 ('The rest of the owners look good').
